evidence.quote: Although our experiments cover multiple budgets, backbones, model scales, and task families, broader evaluation on additional architectures, multi-turn interactions, and production serving systems would further clarify deployment behavior.
This design keeps the method lightweight and scorer-agnostic, but it also means that AMS relies on attention-derived usage as a proxy for long-range utility.
In addition, while AMS is compatible with gather-and-compact KV execution, its practical efficiency may still depend on the serving backend, batching strategy, and hardware implementation.
